name: MOYA (Anwim S.A.)
subsector: fuel retail network and EV charging
desc: Anwim S.A. operates MOYA, a Polish network of about 550 fuel stations with coffee, food, fleet cards and EV charging.
products: road fuels, Caffe MOYA food and coffee, Super MOYA app, MOYA firma fleet programme, MOYA energia EV and truck charging
pe_swf_owner: Stonepeak and Energy Equation Partners (new shareholders from 3 Nov 2026; stakes not stated)
marketing_autonomy_basis: runs its own MOYA consumer brand, app promotions and campaigns (moyastacja.pl news)
stores_or_sites: about 550 fuel stations in Poland (site banner)
markets: Poland nationwide fuel retail and fleet services
profitability_basis: FY2024 net profit EUR 2m (Coface CEE Top 500 2025, rank 69)

signals.what: Stonepeak and Energy Equation Partners became shareholders of Anwim; transaction completed
MOYA energia opened Poland's first public charging corridor for electric heavy trucks (eHDV)

fit_rationale: Fast-growing Polish forecourt brand with a new infrastructure-investor owner and a consumer app base; F1 could lift MOYA's brand against Orlen and BP in fuel and EV charging.
category_conflict: potential: fuel and lubricant partners (Aramco, Shell and others) in F1
outstanding: Stake sizes of Stonepeak and Energy Equation Partners and previous owners not stated on the page; employees from Coface only.

name: RTV Euro AGD (Euro-net sp. z o.o.)
desc: Euro-net runs RTV Euro AGD, a Polish consumer-electronics and appliance retailer with 328 stores and an online shop.
products: consumer electronics, household appliances, IT and mobile devices, online and in-store sales
marketing_autonomy_basis: runs its own national advertising campaigns (e.g. 'Spodziewanki', 2018) per pl.wikipedia
stores_or_sites: 328 RTV Euro AGD stores in 218 localities (2023, pl.wikipedia)
profitability_basis: FY2024 net result PLN 21.78m (pl.wikipedia infobox from KRS)
fit_rationale: Poland's largest founder-owned electronics retailer sells the TV, PC and gaming brands that market around F1; retail promotions and viewing-season campaigns are natural for a mass consumer chain.

access.roles: Chairman of the Management Board (owner); marketing director
